config.tower_topology: four-sided lantern from 089; earlier eight-sided study rejected
observations: 089 close view shows two adjacent broad tower faces, each with three columns and three rows; the eight-sided reduced-footprint study does not match.
102 outer pavilion remains an octagon. Four large sloping trapezoids and four shorter triangular transitions join the square lantern.
001 and 089 support sloped panel rows, a pyramidal cap and a stem with ball at the apex.
101 supplies only conditional proportions. New inner quadrilateral follows parallel offsets of the four long outer source edges so every primary roof facet is planar.
limits: Lantern footprint orientation and dimensions remain source-derived candidates; no calibrated 089 camera solution.
Exact roof subdivision on obscured faces is a symmetry hypothesis.
Mullion sizes, glass thickness, finial and internal tension rods are unmeasured.
The original pavilion stone wall, link, and levels are retained; internal spiral, gallery floor and basement remain separate work.
